item.question: Why is precise mathematical notation important in describing active inference?
item.answer: Precise mathematical notation ensures clarity and consistency when describing complex concepts like active inference. It helps link equations to established references, making it easier for readers familiar with the literature to understand the derivations and mechanisms involved.
